name: io.github.Servosity/td-synnex-mcp
title: TD SYNNEX MCP
description: StreamOne ION reseller API plus a local licence book: renewals, margin, seat true-up

environmentVariables.name: TD_SYNNEX_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your StreamOne ION reseller account ID (portal Quick Access > Account Information). Fills {accountId} in every API path.

environmentVariables.name: TD_SYNNEX_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional override; leave blank. Run `td-synnex-cli auth mint --refresh-token-stdin` once instead: it saves the token this server reads, and `auth mint --if-expiring 15m` keeps it fresh. A pasted access token expires after 2 hours and keeps overriding the saved one.

environmentVariables.name: TD_SYNNEX_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Leave blank. Read only by `td-synnex-cli auth mint` before its first exchange; the MCP server never uses it. ION refresh tokens are single-use, so pipe it to `auth mint --refresh-token-stdin` instead.
